wins.text: Q4 revenue of $14.3B came in at the high end of guidance, up 7% sequentially, driven by solid CCG growth and edge business recovery
Non-GAAP gross margin of 42.1% beat guidance by 260 basis points on higher revenue, better costs, and receipt of first CHIPS grant of $1.1B in Q4
Q4 EPS of $0.13 exceeded guidance of $0.12; Intel Products operating profit was $3.6B at 28% of revenue
Signed definitive CHIPS Act agreement awarding up to $7.86B in grants; received $1.1B in Q4 and additional $1.1B in January Q1
NEX revenue up 7.5% sequentially and more than 20% from Q2 lows as customers return to normal buying patterns; Altera operating margin recovered to 21% from 2% in Q3

risks.text: Q1 2025 revenue guided to $11.7B–$12.7B, down 11%–18% sequentially, well below Q4 levels, citing macro uncertainty, tariff concerns, PC inventory digestion, and increasing competition
Intel Products gross margins under pressure throughout 2025 due to Lunar Lake's higher cost structure (memory-in-package), with meaningful relief not expected until Panther Lake ramps in 2026
Falcon Shores AI accelerator cancelled as a market product; Intel not yet participating meaningfully in cloud-based AI data center market, with Gaudi learnings still being absorbed
Full year 2024 revenue declined 2.1% YoY to $53.1B; Intel Foundry posted greater than $13B operating loss in 2024 with negative gross margins

Tariff-related pull-forward in Q4 (primarily from Asian customers) likely borrowed demand from Q1 2025, adding to sequential revenue headwinds; macro uncertainty flagged as broad risk across all segments

guidance_items.detail: Q1 2025 guided to $11.7B–$12.7B (midpoint $12.2B), down 11%–18% sequentially from Q4's $14.3B; all three Intel Products segments expected to decline at roughly similar rates
Q1 non-GAAP gross margin guided at ~36%, down from Q4's 42.1%; Q1 expected to be the low point for the year with improvement thereafter
Q1 non-GAAP EPS guided to breakeven ($0.00), down from Q4's $0.13
2025 gross CapEx guided to ~$20B, at the low end of prior $20B–$23B range; net CapEx expected at $8B–$11B after offsets
2025 OpEx target of $17.5B maintained; Intel Foundry breakeven operating income target by end of 2027 reaffirmed; Intel Products gross margin expected to decline in 2025 vs. 51% in 2024

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Competitive pricing pressure in both client and server CPU markets and its impact on gross margins throughout 2025
Path to free cash flow positivity in 2025 given Q1 weakness and macro uncertainty
Extent and persistence of tariff-driven Q4 pull-forward demand and its drag on Q1
